response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL') AND player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE round = 'WS') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC, player_id ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Total triples sums over all of the player's postseason batting records (any league, any round), not just the NL or WS records; the NL and WS conditions only determine eligibility.
Ties in the total are broken by player_id ascending for deterministic output; the request does not specify a tie-break.
NULL totals sort last (the triple column is INTEGER; a player whose triples are all NULL would have a NULL sum, and ORDER BY DESC puts NULLs last in SQLite only if handled explicitly).
